claim(uint256).details: Uses epochAddrCapBps snapshot to ensure changes to ADDR_CAP_BPS never alter past ended rewards.

cumulativeDailyQuota(uint256).details: Sum_{k=1..d} D0 * r^(k-1) = D0 * (1 - r^d) / (1 - r)      Where: D0 = 3,000,000e18, r = 0.9967e18 -> 1 - r = 0.0033e18 = 3.3e15      D0 / (1 - r) = 3,000,000e18 / 3.3e15 = 3e24 / 3.3e15 = 3e9 / 3.3 = 30e9 / 33 = 10_000_000_000 / 11.      Since (1e18 - r^d) is scaled by 1e18, the formula:      (10_000_000_000 * (1e18 - rd)) / 11 gives the exact sum in 18-decimal wei.      WARNING: If D0 or DECAY is ever modified, this ratio must be recalculated!
